features: Independent Left/Right/Base input codecs and actual BOM/EOL summary
Graphical source-line alignment and marker management
Atomic selected folder/subtree refresh with freshness/sync guards
Selected text versus Unicode clipboard in a fresh memory-only tab
Manual syntax overrides and portable extension mappings
Streaming literal UTF-8/UTF-16 pager Find/Find Next
Fingerprint-bound block notes, metadata I/O and annotated three-way HTML

limitations: Physical clipboard interoperability was not exercised; selection/clipboard tests inject synthetic Unicode without altering the real clipboard.
Physical wheel gestures, mixed-monitor DPI, maximum-quota throughput and injected allocation/power failures were not tested.
C/C++ outline is heuristic; complex constructs may be omitted. Pager Find is literal UTF-8/UTF-16 only.
Syntax associations apply to normal file Text editors and shared clones.
Unsaved review notes are not stored in workspace/crash recovery; explicit metadata Save and normal-close prompts are implemented.
publication: No commit, push or GitHub write
